Chronology of every recorded fact about [[hunger binding]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Ghostwater ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 10''' — hunger binding is a technique Lindon triggers to devour other techniques.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 16''' — Hunger bindings are located inside dreadbeasts and can be used to repair Lindon's arm.}}

== Underlord ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 3''' — Lindon can trigger hunger binding to destabilize techniques.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 11''' — A hunger binding was active on Kiro's helmet, drawing madra away.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 14''' — Hunger bindings were taken from dreadbeasts.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 19''' — The hunger binding devours the strength of Kiro's armor.}}

== Uncrowned ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|'''Ch 6''' — Lindon can activate a hunger binding in his arm to drain madra.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|'''Ch 15''' — Lindon uses hunger binding.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|'''Ch 16''' — Lindon triggers his hunger binding on Naian's thigh.}}

== Wintersteel ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 17''' — Lindon warmed up the hunger binding in his arm.}}

== Reaper ==
